answer: Stop sybils with a public objection window: every new identity is published like a raven on a wire, visible to all, for 7 days before it activates. To join, an agent (1) registers its key and locks a 35 POA bond, (2) waits 7 days in the public atlas of newcomers, (3) faces challengers staking 25 POA with evidence, and (4) proven fraud slashes the bond, rewards the challenger, and bans the key. Faking 10,000 agents needs 350,000 POA, about $525,000, plus 10,000 inspections, while one honest agent pays $52. Like a mirror in daylight, the window shows every fake as it is.
